title: Wanchain-family + Rango chain-coverage verification — 2026-09-05 (live, read-only)
method: Live HTTP probes only (no funds, no broadcast). web_search was unavailable; all sources fetched directly.
context: Mission premise to verify: 'Wanchain is the primary ADA/SUI/Polkadot rail'. Verdict: NOT SUPPORTED by any public HTTP API today — see per-surface evidence below. Rango re-verified: no Cardano/Polkadot (confirmed).

live_tokenPairs_capture.verdict: EVM-class chains ONLY. NO Cardano, Sui, Polkadot, Solana, Tron-native, XRP-Ledger-native, or native UTXO chains. 'BTC'/'ADA'/'DOGE' symbols in the pair data are wrapped EVM representations (e.g. BTC on BNB/AVAX/ETH), not native chains. The docs' own 'verify the pair via tokenPairs' caveat FAILS for the non-EVM chains the welcome matrix claims.

live_supported_tokens.note: every non-EVM token row is flagged wanBridgeOnly:true

live_quote_probes.method: POST /api/v3/quote with valid-format addresses (CIP-19 Cardano vector; base58 SOL; bech32 BTC; base58check TRON)

failed_routes.ADA (Cardano native) -> SOL: get quotes failed … From Chain not supported / Unsupported chain #1
failed_routes.USDC (Ethereum) -> SOL native (control): no token pair for SOL cross ETH -> SOL (Unsupported token #2) — SOL has NO quotable pairs via this API at all

xflows_v3_api.verdict: The ONLY Wanchain-family quote+buildTx HTTP API. Its registries LIST Cardano/Sui/BTC/SOL/TRON chains+tokens, but the quote router serves NONE of them today — every non-EVM source → SOL probe failed, and even EVM USDC → SOL has no pair. Quotable coverage today = EVM-chain pairs only (which our app already serves via the LiFi/Warp rail; Wanchain EVM routes land on EVM/Wanchain-L1, never Solana or X1).

intent_api.verdict: 7 EVM chains only — no non-EVM coverage.

bridge_portal.note: The docs 'new version' manual walks Cardano(ADA, Nami wallet) → Wanchain and BTC → Wanchain through THIS portal. The portal's non-EVM pair registry + fee/quota calls are ON-CHAIN (iWan JSON-RPC to Wanchain L1 storeman contracts — 25-node bridge group, 17-of-25 sMPC threshold, monthly rotation), NOT a documented public REST quote API. The docs welcome matrix claims WanBridge covers Cardano/Sui/Polkadot/Solana/Tron/UTXOs — product-level claim only; no public API exposes quotes for those routes, and live operational status of the Cardano storeman lane could not be verified without portal/on-chain sessions.
bridge_portal.verdict: Not integrable as an HTTP quote rail today. Would need (a) Mr. Esters' ruling to treat it as a deposit-address/out-of-band lane like THORChain (user drives the portal), or (b) Wanchain shipping a public API for the storeman routes.

rango_reverify.source: https://public-api.rango.exchange/basic/meta (Rango docs' public TEST key c6381a79-2817-4602-83bf-6a641a409e32 — read-only)
rango_reverify.verdict: Last night's finding CONFIRMED: Rango serves SUI/TRON/XRPL/BTC-family/TON/Stellar; it does NOT serve Cardano or Polkadot. (DOT appears only as bridged EVM assets on BASE/OPTIMISM — not a POLKADOT source chain.)

security_note.night_exploit: June 2022: the third-party NIGHT token's own cross-chain bridge contract on Wanchain was exploited (attacker minted NIGHT; widely reported ~$1M-scale at the time). The compromise was the NIGHT project's custom bridge contract, NOT the Wanchain storeman bridge node infrastructure.
security_note.current_posture: Wanchain docs (2026): WanBridge secured by 25 decentralised bridge nodes, rotated/re-elected monthly, 17-of-25 threshold, sMPC + Shamir Secret Sharing; storeman economics = SecRand selection, threshold TSS, deposits + falling-price auction to compensate users. No Wanchain-core bridge exploit publicly documented since NIGHT. No public audit history found in the docs (independent audits should be a live-test open item if a Wanchain lane ever goes live).

coverage_matrix.note: Rails listed per source in priority order — ONLY rails whose live API actually serves the route. Drives teleportRail railCandidates + docs/ROUTING-ENGINE.md.

polkadot: NO RAIL — Rango ❌ / THORChain ❌ / XFlows ❌ (not even a chain row). Do not list as a console source.
